teamInfo.title: Team Information
teamInfo.intro: Airi.chat is built by a small team working on official WhatsApp campaigns, AI replies and follow-ups. Key members:

aisulu.description: Co-founder who leads customer success. She saw the problem at a large bank in Kazakhstan, where more than 50 analysts sorted complaints and opened tickets by hand.

samat.description: Co-founder responsible for product UX, developer experience and system reliability.

teamInfo.pmf: We are still early and work closely with our customers on the way to product-market fit.

products.title: What Airi.chat does
products.intro: Airi.chat helps businesses sell through WhatsApp. You send campaigns through the official WhatsApp Business Platform, answer customers yourself or with AI, and follow up with the people who replied. Templates, WhatsApp Flows, customer lists and sales analytics are built in, and Instagram, Telegram, email and web chat work in the same workspace.

problems.overwhelmed: WhatsApp campaigns go out from different tools, and replies don’t get a timely follow-up.
problems.visibility: Replies, opt-ins and purchase signals get lost between inboxes.
problems.manualAnalysis: Segmenting customers and reading replies by hand slows down the next campaign.
problems.audienceCompanies: Online stores, SaaS, fintech, education and service companies that talk to customers in WhatsApp.
problems.audienceTeams: Marketing and sales teams that send large WhatsApp campaigns and want automation with a person ready to step in.

products.closing: With Airi.chat, a campaign doesn’t end at the send. You see who replied, sort the audience by their answers and follow up with context.

what.question: What is Airi.chat?
what.answer: Airi.chat is a platform for sending official WhatsApp campaigns and handling the replies. Your team answers customers with the help of AI and follows up with the people who responded.

founders.question: Who founded Airi.chat?
founders.answer: Airi.chat was founded by Aisulu Kalshabekova (Co-Founder & CEO) and Samat Kalshabekov (Co-Founder & CTO).

problems.question: What problems does Airi.chat solve?
problems.answer: It replaces scattered campaign tools and risky unofficial sending services, and it keeps replies and purchase signals from getting lost after a campaign.

audience.question: Who is Airi.chat for?
audience.answer: For marketing and sales teams at online stores, SaaS, fintech, education and service companies that send WhatsApp campaigns and need to handle the replies.

start.question: What do I need to get started?
start.answer: Create a workspace, connect a channel, and add the business information your team uses to answer customers. For WhatsApp campaigns, connect your business account and prepare an approved template.

number.question: Can I use my existing WhatsApp number?
number.answer: You can connect an eligible WhatsApp Business number. Keeping the Business app alongside the platform depends on your account and Meta’s eligibility requirements. We can help you check before you connect.

ai.question: Does AI handle every conversation?
ai.answer: You choose how AI is used. It can answer from your business knowledge or help prepare a campaign. Your team can take over conversations and review campaign drafts before sending.

cost.question: Are WhatsApp message charges included?
cost.answer: Meta bills WhatsApp messages separately. airi.chat does not include those message fees.

crm.question: Do I need a CRM to use airi.chat?
crm.answer: No. You can start with connected channels, customer conversations, campaigns, and business knowledge inside airi.chat. A CRM is not required for these workflows.

welcome.description: Welcome a new customer and offer help.
welcome.body:
Hi Alex! Welcome to *airi.chat*.
What would you like to improve first: customer replies or follow-ups? Pick a topic and start a conversation with our team.

order-confirmation.title: Order confirmation
order-confirmation.description: Confirm an order and explain the next step.
order-confirmation.body:
Hi Alex! Your sample order *#1042* is confirmed.
We would send the next update when it is ready. Need help with this example? Choose a reply below.

shipping-update.title: Shipping update
shipping-update.description: Share shipment status and estimated arrival.
shipping-update.body:
Good news, Alex! Sample order *#1042* is on its way.
Estimated arrival: *Thursday*.
Want help with a delivery question? Reply in this demo conversation.

appointment-reminder.title: Appointment reminder
appointment-reminder.description: Remind customers of an appointment and ask for confirmation.
appointment-reminder.body:
Hi Alex! Your sample appointment is *tomorrow at 14:00*.
Would you keep this time or ask to reschedule? Choose a reply below to try the conversation.

course-enrollment.title: Course enrollment
course-enrollment.description: Preview course enrollment in a WhatsApp Flow.
course-enrollment.body:
Hi Alex! Ready to explore *WhatsApp automation*?
Open the short form, choose a sample course and try completing it inside WhatsApp. This demo does not enroll you.

payment-reminder.title: Payment reminder
payment-reminder.description: Remind customers about an invoice and due date.
payment-reminder.body:
Hi Alex. Sample invoice *#204* is due on *Friday*.
Already paid, or have a question? Choose a reply below to try a payment follow-up. No payment is requested by this demo.

feedback.title: Customer feedback
feedback.description: Ask about a recent customer experience.
feedback.body:
Hi Alex! How was your sample visit to *our showroom*?
Choose a reply and tell us what worked well or what could be better. One quick answer can start a useful conversation.

back-in-stock.title: Back in stock
back-in-stock.description: Show restocked products in a carousel.
back-in-stock.body:
Hi Alex! Your sample favorites are back: *Terra, Mora and Lino*.
Swipe through the collection. Which one would you choose for your room?

birthday-offer.title: Birthday offer
birthday-offer.description: Send a birthday greeting and offer.
birthday-offer.body:
Happy birthday, Alex! 🎉
Here is a fictional birthday treat: use *BIRTHDAY* in this sample shopping journey.
Would you pick a gift for yourself or explore a home idea?

enquiry-follow-up.title: Enquiry follow-up
enquiry-follow-up.description: Follow up on an enquiry with a question.
enquiry-follow-up.body:
*airi.chat demo · fictional example*

Hi Alex — still exploring a customer messaging setup?

A short conversation can help you compare the next steps. What would be most useful: a price overview or a walkthrough?

_Try a sample reply below; no consultation is scheduled._

discovery-recap.title: Call recap
discovery-recap.description: Summarize the priorities discussed on a call.
discovery-recap.body:
*airi.chat demo · fictional example*

*Your sample discovery recap*

Hi Alex, here are the priorities we discussed:
• Answer new enquiries consistently
• Keep appointment changes in one conversation
• Review results each week

*Next step:* compare a simple pilot with your current process.

_This example does not record a real meeting._

quote-ready.title: Quote
quote-ready.description: Send a price summary and PDF proposal.
quote-ready.body:
*airi.chat demo · fictional example*

*Your sample quote is ready*

Reference: Q-204
Scope: home styling consultation and product shortlist
Illustrative total: *180 USD*

Open the attached PDF to see what is included and which questions to ask before deciding.

_This fictional proposal is not an offer, invoice or payment request._

quote-question.title: Quote follow-up
quote-question.description: Ask a question about a quote.
quote-question.body:
*airi.chat demo · fictional example*

Hi Alex — one quick question about sample quote *Q-204*.

Would a clearer scope or a different timing option help you decide?

_Tap a sample reply to try the interaction; the quote is fictional._

proposal-comparison.title: Proposal comparison
proposal-comparison.description: Compare two options and their scope.
proposal-comparison.body:
*airi.chat demo · fictional example*

*Choose a starting point*

*Option A · Focused pilot*
One customer journey, a small team and a review after two weeks.

*Option B · Broader rollout*
Three customer journeys, shared guidelines and a monthly review.

Which approach feels closer to your needs?

_These are fictional options, not a purchase or service commitment._

decision-check-in.title: Decision follow-up
decision-check-in.description: Ask whether a lead wants to continue or pause.
decision-check-in.body:
*airi.chat demo · fictional example*

Hi Alex, is your messaging pilot still on your shortlist?

If the timing has changed, that is fine. You can explore an example now or leave the conversation for later.

_This is a sample follow-up, with no real project attached._

showroom-visit-follow-up.title: Showroom follow-up
showroom-visit-follow-up.description: Follow up on a product after a showroom visit.
showroom-visit-follow-up.body:
*airi.chat demo · fictional example*

*A detail from your sample showroom visit*

Hi Alex, the *Terra vase* works well as a single focal point on a quiet shelf.

Before choosing, compare the shelf depth, the vase height and the natural light in your room.

_The visit and product interest are fictional. No item is reserved._

home-service-quote.title: Service quote
home-service-quote.description: Collect project details in a quote Flow.
home-service-quote.body:
*airi.chat demo · fictional example*

*Try a home service estimate*

Choose a sample service, job size and fictional service area. Review optional extras and timing before completing the demo.

_No address, phone number or payment is requested. No quote or service visit is created._

appointment-booking.title: Appointment booking
appointment-booking.description: Preview booking an appointment in WhatsApp.
appointment-booking.body:
*airi.chat demo · fictional example*

*Try an appointment booking*

Pick a sample service, choose a date and time, then review the details together.

_This airi.chat Flow is a fictional booking exercise. It does not reserve a slot or collect contact details._

restaurant-table.title: Table booking
restaurant-table.description: Choose a party size and seating preferences.
restaurant-table.body:
*airi.chat demo · fictional example*

*Try a table reservation*

Choose a sample date, party size and seating preference. The review step makes the choices easy to check.

_No restaurant table is booked, and no personal details are requested._

travel-date-range.title: Travel planning
travel-date-range.description: Choose travel dates and trip preferences.
travel-date-range.body:
*airi.chat demo · fictional example*

*A little trip planning, inside WhatsApp*

Choose sample travel dates, a room preference and a few extras, then review the plan.

_This is a fictional itinerary exercise. No tickets, rooms or travel services are reserved._

event-registration.title: Event registration
event-registration.description: Choose an event session and review the details.
event-registration.body:
*airi.chat demo · fictional example*

*Try an event registration*

Choose a sample session and participation preferences, then complete the short review.

_This demo does not issue a ticket, register an attendee or request personal details._

appointment-rescheduled.title: Appointment change
appointment-rescheduled.body:
*airi.chat demo · fictional example*

*Sample appointment updated*

Reference: DEMO-A-318
Previous time: 14 Oct 2026, 14:30 UTC
*New time: 15 Oct 2026, 14:30 UTC*

Please check the difference before planning your day.

_This is a fictional schedule change; no real appointment has been modified._

visit-preparation.title: Visit checklist
visit-preparation.description: Send a checklist before a service visit.
visit-preparation.body:
*airi.chat demo · fictional example*

*Before your sample consultation*

For a room styling consultation, a little preparation helps:
• Note your three main questions
• Bring any relevant reference photos
• Check the appointment time and travel plan

_This checklist illustrates a reminder. No visit is booked._

delivery-preferences.title: Delivery preferences
delivery-preferences.description: Choose delivery preferences in a WhatsApp Flow.
delivery-preferences.body:
*airi.chat demo · fictional example*

*Try choosing delivery preferences*

Explore sample collection or delivery choices, a fictional location and a time window, then review the selection.

_This demo does not change a shipment or collect an address. Please use only the provided sample choices._

return-request.title: Return request
return-request.description: Choose a return reason and review the options.
return-request.body:
*airi.chat demo · fictional example*

*Try a return request*

Use a sample reference, choose a return reason and explore a resolution. Review the fictional handoff options before completing the demo.

_No order is changed, collection arranged or refund requested._

pickup-ready.title: Pickup location
pickup-ready.description: Share pickup details and a location pin.
pickup-ready.body:
*airi.chat demo · fictional example*

*A sample pickup message with a map pin*

Order DEMO-O-426 is marked ready in this fictional example.

The pin shows the *Eiffel Tower in Paris* as a public-landmark demonstration point. It is *not an airi.chat address or a real collection point*.

_Do not travel there to collect an order. Open the pin to explore the location format._

repair-progress.title: Repair update
repair-progress.description: Share repair status and the next step.
repair-progress.body:
*airi.chat demo · fictional example*

*Sample repair update*

Case: DEMO-R-182
Item: a desk lamp
*Stage:* inspection complete
*Next:* review the proposed repair steps

The example keeps the status readable without suggesting work is already finished.

_No device or real repair case is attached._

service-completed.title: Service completion
service-completed.description: Summarize completed work and the next step.
service-completed.body:
*airi.chat demo · fictional example*

*Sample service complete*

Reference: S-1042
Work shown in this example:
• Checked the agreed scope
• Recorded the outcome
• Prepared a short handover checklist

Keep the summary somewhere easy to find before the next visit.

_This fictional message does not confirm real work._

refund-status.title: Refund status
refund-status.description: Show a sample refund stage and amount.
refund-status.body:
*airi.chat demo · fictional example*

*Sample refund status*

Reference: DEMO-RF-091
Illustrative amount: *24 USD*
Stage: review completed; processing is the next step in this example.

A real business would confirm its own payment status before sending this message.

_No refund has been requested, approved or paid._

subscription-renewal.title: Subscription renewal
subscription-renewal.description: Remind a subscriber to review their plan before renewal.
subscription-renewal.body:
*airi.chat demo · fictional example*

*Review a sample renewal*

Plan: Studio monthly
Illustrative renewal date: 31 Oct 2026

Before the next cycle, check whether the plan still fits your needs and which features you actually use.

_This fictional reminder does not renew a subscription or request payment._

service-summary.title: Service summary
service-summary.description: Send completed work and next steps in a PDF.
service-summary.body:
*airi.chat demo · fictional example*

*Your sample service summary*

Reference: S-1042
The attached PDF shows a concise care handover: what was completed, helpful recommendations and a follow-up plan.

_This fictional document is not proof of work, an invoice or a warranty._

product-finder.title: Product finder
product-finder.description: Choose preferences to see a sample product recommendation.
product-finder.body:
*airi.chat demo · fictional example*

*Try a product finder*

Choose how you want to use an item, a sample budget and useful features. Review a suggested direction at the end.

_This demo does not check live stock or place an order._

product-comparison.title: Product comparison
product-comparison.description: Compare three products in a carousel.
product-comparison.body:
*airi.chat demo · fictional example*

*A clearer product comparison*

Swipe through three fictional homeware options. Each card focuses on a different use, so the choice starts with what your room needs.

_Images are illustrative. Dimensions, stock and prices are not a live offer._

To unsubscribe: samat@airi.chat

cards.body:
*Terra vase*
A sculptural focal point for a shelf or side table.
_Best for: one simple statement._

*Mora baskets*
Woven storage for everyday items.
_Best for: texture with a practical purpose._

*Lino throw*
A soft layer for a sofa or reading corner.
_Best for: an easy change in mood._

room-styling.title: Room ideas
room-styling.description: Show matching items in a carousel.
room-styling.body:
*airi.chat demo · fictional example*

*Three layers for a calmer room*

Start with a focal point, add a useful texture, then finish with a soft layer. Swipe to see a fictional styling combination.

_This is an illustrative room idea, not a bundle price or a product reservation._

To unsubscribe: samat@airi.chat

cards.body:
*1 · Add a focal point*
Give a vase a little breathing room so its shape stands out.

*2 · Add useful texture*
A woven basket can keep small everyday objects together.

*3 · Add a soft finish*
Fold a throw where it adds a gentle change of texture.

product-care.title: Product care
product-care.description: Send product care tips in a video.
product-care.body:
*airi.chat demo · fictional example*

*A little care goes a long way*

Watch three illustrative reminders for the Terra vase: use a soft damp cloth, dry gently and avoid abrasive pads.

_The clip is a fictional product demo. Follow the instructions supplied with your actual item._

bundle-idea.title: Product pairing
bundle-idea.description: Show how two products work together.
bundle-idea.body:
*airi.chat demo · fictional example*

*A sample pairing for everyday use*

The *Mora basket* can hold a throw beside a sofa, keeping both close at hand.

Think about the space you have and what you reach for each day before adding anything new.

_This is a fictional styling suggestion, with no bundle price or checkout._

sizing-guide.title: Size guide
sizing-guide.description: Show product dimensions beside an image.
sizing-guide.body:
*airi.chat demo · fictional example*

*A sample basket sizing guide*

Small: *24 × 18 cm*
Large: *32 × 24 cm*

Measure your shelf opening and leave room to lift the basket out comfortably.

_These dimensions are fictional examples, not specifications for a product on sale._

gift-selection.title: Gift selection
gift-selection.description: Ask a question to help choose a gift.
gift-selection.body:
*airi.chat demo · fictional example*

*A thoughtful gift starts with one question*

Hi Alex — is this sample gift for a home lover, a host or someone who enjoys a quiet moment?

A useful preference can make the choice feel more personal.

_The gift and recipient are fictional. Reply buttons demonstrate a choice only._

onboarding-guide.title: Getting started
onboarding-guide.description: Send a PDF guide with setup steps.
onboarding-guide.body:
*airi.chat demo · fictional example*

*Start with a simple guide*

Hi Alex, the attached sample guide walks through connecting a business channel, preparing templates, designing a customer journey and testing before launch.

Keep it nearby as an example of a helpful onboarding document.

_No account, integration or service is activated by this demo._

event-agenda.title: Event agenda
event-agenda.description: Send an event schedule as a document.
event-agenda.body:
*airi.chat demo · fictional example*

*Your sample event agenda*

Event: Customer conversations workshop
Illustrative schedule: 10:00–11:00

The PDF brings the session order and key themes into one easy-to-save page.

_This is a fictional event. The document is not a ticket or registration confirmation._

first-week-checklist.title: First-week checklist
first-week-checklist.description: Share tasks for a learner’s first week.
first-week-checklist.body:
*airi.chat demo · fictional example*

*Your sample first-week checklist*

For Customer conversations basics, start with three small steps:
☐ Watch the introductory lesson
☐ Try one short exercise
☐ Write down one question to revisit

Progress is easier to see when the first week has a clear shape.

_This fictional checklist does not enroll you or track your learning._

account-setup-checklist.title: Messaging pilot
account-setup-checklist.description: Plan a customer journey, content and result to review.
account-setup-checklist.body:
*airi.chat demo · fictional example*

*A sample setup checklist*

Before launching a messaging pilot:
☐ Choose one customer journey
☐ Agree who owns replies
☐ Prepare the sample message content
☐ Decide what a useful result looks like

Start small enough to review the outcome.

_This example does not change account settings or connect a channel._

subscription-change-summary.title: Plan change
subscription-change-summary.description: Show the old and new plan details.
subscription-change-summary.body:
*airi.chat demo · fictional example*

*Sample plan change summary*

Previous plan: Studio monthly
New plan: *Studio annual*
Illustrative effective date: 1 Nov 2026

A real service would confirm the billing terms separately.

_No plan, charge or subscription has been changed by this demo._

privacy-request-acknowledgement.title: Privacy request
privacy-request-acknowledgement.description: Acknowledge a privacy enquiry and explain the next step.
privacy-request-acknowledgement.body:
*airi.chat demo · fictional example*

*Sample privacy enquiry acknowledgement*

Reference: DEMO-PR-014

This example shows the information a business might share after receiving an enquiry: a reference number, the review stage and a clear contact path.

_This demo has not created a privacy request, verified identity or processed personal data._

contact-airi.title: Contact options
contact-airi.description: Choose how to contact airi.chat in a Flow.
contact-airi.body:
*airi.chat demo · fictional example*

*Get in touch with airi.chat*

Explore a short contact preference demo, then choose how you would like to reach us yourself.

*WhatsApp / phone:* +7 708 260 93 46
*Email:* samat@airi.chat

_The Flow does not book a call or request a callback. It collects no personal contact details._

preference-center.title: Message preferences
preference-center.body:
*airi.chat demo · fictional example*

*Try a message preference center*

Choose the sample topics and message frequency you prefer, then review the selection.

_This fictional Flow does not change your real subscriptions or marketing consent. For actual unsubscribe requests, use the email below._

feedback-survey.title: Feedback survey
feedback-survey.description: Choose a rating and feedback topics in a Flow.
feedback-survey.body:
*airi.chat demo · fictional example*

*Try a short feedback survey*

Choose a sample rating and the areas you would like to comment on. Review your choices before completing the demo.

_This is a fictional feedback exercise, not a review of a real business visit. Please do not enter personal information._

company-contact.title: Company contacts
company-contact.description: Share airi.chat’s phone and email with a call button.
company-contact.body:
*airi.chat demo · fictional example*

*Reach airi.chat directly*

Questions about customer conversations on WhatsApp?

*Phone / WhatsApp:* +7 708 260 93 46
*Email:* samat@airi.chat
*Website:* https://www.airi.chat/

The call button opens your phone's dialler for the real company number. The contact details are real; this message demonstrates how to share them.

branch-directory.title: Branch location
branch-directory.description: Show a sample branch with a location pin.
branch-directory.body:
*airi.chat demo · fictional example*

*A sample branch directory message*

Open the pin to explore the *Sydney Opera House* as a public-landmark location example.

This is *not an airi.chat office, partner branch or a service location*. The name and address help demonstrate how a real branch pin would appear.

_No appointment, ticket or business visit is arranged._

service-hours.title: Service hours
service-hours.body:
*airi.chat demo · fictional example*

*Sample service hours*

Monday–Friday: *09:00–18:00*
Saturday: *10:00–14:00*
Sunday: closed

A real business can use a compact message like this to set expectations before someone visits.

_These are fictional shop hours, not airi.chat's opening or support hours._

human-handoff.title: Team handoff
human-handoff.description: Explain when a team member takes over the conversation.
human-handoff.body:
*airi.chat demo · fictional example*

*A sample handoff message*

Hi Alex, this is how a messaging assistant could explain the next step:

“Your question needs a colleague's attention. We will include the conversation context so you do not have to repeat it.”

_This example does not assign your conversation or notify a colleague. Reply buttons are illustrative only._

learning-path.title: Learning path
learning-path.description: Choose learning goals, experience and topics.
learning-path.body:
*airi.chat demo · fictional example*

*Find a sample learning direction*

Choose your goal, your current experience and the topics that interest you. Review a learning path that brings those choices together.

_This fictional Flow does not enroll you, assess your skills or collect personal details._

lesson-recap.title: Lesson recap
lesson-recap.description: Summarize the main ideas from a lesson.
lesson-recap.body:
*airi.chat demo · fictional example*

*A sample lesson recap · Clear customer replies*

Three ideas to keep:
• Start with the customer's actual question
• Make the next step easy to understand
• Keep a human owner for complex cases

*Try this:* rewrite one long reply as two short, clear sentences.

_This message illustrates learning support; no real course progress is recorded._

practice-challenge.title: Practice task
practice-challenge.description: Suggest a five-minute task to practice one idea.
practice-challenge.body:
*airi.chat demo · fictional example*

*A small practice challenge*

You have five minutes. Turn this sample reply into a clearer next step:

“We received your message and will take the relevant actions in accordance with our process.”

Aim for one useful action and one clear expectation.

_This is a fictional exercise. Reply buttons do not submit graded work._

study-plan.title: Weekly study plan
study-plan.description: Share study tasks spread across the week.
study-plan.body:
*airi.chat demo · fictional example*

*A sample weekly plan · Clear customer conversations*

*Monday:* read one short example
*Wednesday:* rewrite one reply in your own words
*Friday:* compare your first and latest attempts

Keep each session to about 15 minutes and focus on one improvement.

_This fictional plan does not create reminders or enroll you in a course._

webinar-follow-up.title: Webinar follow-up
webinar-follow-up.description: Suggest a next step after a webinar.
webinar-follow-up.body:
*airi.chat demo · fictional example*

*One takeaway from a sample webinar*

Session: Better customer conversations

Before automating a conversation, write down:
1. The customer's question
2. The useful next step
3. When a person should take over

That small outline is a practical place to start.

_The webinar is fictional; this message does not provide a recording or register you for another event._

loyalty-milestone.title: Loyalty milestone
loyalty-milestone.body:
*airi.chat demo · fictional example*

*A sample customer milestone*

Hi Alex, this example marks *5 thoughtful visits* to a fictional homeware store.

A warm thank-you can make a milestone feel personal without turning every message into an offer.

_No points, voucher, purchase history or reward has been created._

care-check-in.title: Care follow-up
care-check-in.description: Ask about product care after a purchase.
care-check-in.body:
*airi.chat demo · fictional example*

*A sample care check-in*

Hi Alex, have you found a useful spot for the *Mora basket*?

Keep woven storage away from damp areas and check the maker's instructions before cleaning.

_This is a fictional follow-up. Reply buttons demonstrate a response and do not create a support case._

community-invitation.title: Community invitation
community-invitation.description: Invite customers to a sample community session.
community-invitation.body:
*airi.chat demo · fictional example*

*A sample invitation · A calmer corner*

Bring one small styling question and explore how a vase, a woven basket and a soft throw can change a reading corner.

The idea is to share practical inspiration, with no purchase required.

_This fictional session has no scheduled date, ticket or registration. The button opens airi.chat._

actions.stranded: This action appears interrupted. Check Meta Ads Manager before recording what happened.

canva-whatsapp-campaign.title: Canva WhatsApp campaign
canva-whatsapp-campaign.description: Plan Canva creative and a WhatsApp template for a bulk send.
